![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151148/assets/7f2467ce2b4c3e1a446b3fb50b88c77ad70db02293f7f8a8f76ba4bd718bebdb.png)

For the diagram shown above, which of the following statements are true?

I. The segments $\overset{―}{DB}$ and $\overset{―}{BE}$ are not congruent

II. $\overset{―}{AD}≅\overset{―}{BE}$

III. $CE\ne 5\,\text{cm}$
question.worked_solution:
- Statement I is false. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{DB}$ and $\overset{―}{BE}$ have the same hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{DB}≅\overset{―}{BE}.
$$

- Statement II is false. According to the picture, we have that $\overset{―}{AD}$ and $\overset{―}{BE}$ have different hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{AD}≇\overset{―}{BE}.
$$

- Statement III is true. According to the picture, we have that $\overset{―}{BE}$ and $\overset{―}{CE}$ have different hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{BE}≇\overset{―}{CE}.
$$

Hence, $BE\ne CE,$ and since $BE=5\,\text{cm}$, we have $CE\ne 5\,\text{cm}.$,

Therefore, only statement III is true.
